problems: Caption 'Botox should' / 'expression' / 'in the' are single-word fragments that do not match the voice and are hard to follow
Captions and hook box sit over the woman's chest/hands area and overlap the face region in the first frames, crowding the visual
Frames at 0.7s and 2.1s are near-identical (same woman, same pose), so the opening feels static
Frame at 6.3s and 7.6s: blurry macro eye through a magnifier with flowers, out of focus, looks unrelated to Botox and no caption
The injection-like clip with a marker pen at 3.5-4.9s looks more like a procedure mapping, not clearly natural expression Botox
qa.fix: Replace the blurry magnifier eye shots and the duplicate opening frame with sharp, varied med spa footage (smiling expressive face, treatment room in Brooklyn), use full-phrase captions synced to the voice, and give the end card one clear CTA with a logo and shorter hold.
